Class Channel<K,V>

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.api.Channel<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - key type
V - value type
public final class Channel<K,V> extends Object
A typed topic a process receives from or sends to.

A channel binds a topic name to the serdes for its keys and values. Causal metadata travels in reserved headers and never in the key or value, so a channel's serdes describe only the application's own data.

    • startingAt

      public Channel<K,V> startingAt(Channel.InitialPosition initialPosition)
      Returns a copy of this channel with a different starting position.

      The starting position applies only where no committed position exists. It has no effect on a process resuming from committed state.

      Parameters:
      initialPosition - where to begin reading
      Returns:
      a new channel, leaving this one unchanged
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if initialPosition is null
